name: Storm Burger
facts: Two locations: Inglewood (1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302) and Long Beach (5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805). Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd) is coming soon.
Inglewood hours: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.
Long Beach hours: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.
Rewards earn 20 points for every $1 spent.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts Free fries, 1,800 pts Free shake, 3,000 pts Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 pts Free combo.
Bonuses: 50 pts check-in, 100 pts first order, 200 pts birthday, 250 pts for in-app feedback.
Joining offer: free fries with your next burger.
Storm Run is free to play with no account. You only need a free member account to save a score or claim a prize.
Storm Run has 10 levels of 90 seconds each and 5 lives. Every hit costs half a life.
Game prizes: 400 pts free house sauce, 600 pts free fries or onion rings, 800 pts free milkshake, 1,000 pts free Classic StormBurger.
Weekly champion (top score by Sunday close) wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday.
Game prizes must be used within 3 days, and you can hold one prize at a time.
Free daily spin: one per member per day (Los Angeles time), and every slice wins.
Combos come with fries and a soft drink. Upgrade fries to onion rings +$2.00 or the drink to a milkshake +$2.00.
Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99, Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99.
Sauces are homemade, $1.00 each.
You can build your own burger or chicken sandwich in the app and place the order.
Order buttons in the app: Order Inglewood and Order Long Beach.
No phone number is shown in the app. Ask staff at the counter for help.
Menu photos in the app are AI-generated previews of the real items.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.
suggested: What rewards can I get and what do they cost?
How do I play Storm Run and win prizes?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM. Long Beach: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: What time does the Inglewood location open and close?
qa.a: Inglewood opens at 10:30 AM every day. It closes at 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday.

qa.q: What time does the Long Beach location open and close?
qa.a: Long Beach opens at 10:30 AM every day. It closes at 10 PM Monday–Wednesday and 11 PM Thursday–Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open late at night?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday. Long Beach closes at 10 PM Monday–Wednesday and 11 PM Thursday–Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM and Sunday 10:30 AM–12 AM. Long Beach is open Thursday–Sunday 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. A Compton spot is coming soon.

qa.q: What is the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is there a Compton location?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under your location in the app.

qa.q: Where can I park?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to share here. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How can I contact someone for help?
qa.a: Ask any team member at the counter. I don't have a phone number to give you.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach in the app. You can also build your own burger or chicken sandwich and place the order.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: The app mentions scanning the table QR to start earning stars. I don't have more detail on table ordering, so ask staff if you need help.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I order for pickup or delivery?
qa.a: The app has order buttons for Inglewood and Long Beach. I don't have details on pickup or delivery, so please ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have drive-thru details for the real restaurants. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: The app lists Combos, burgers, a Kids Burger, a Turkey Burger, a Mix Shake and homemade sauces. You can also build your own burger or chicken sandwich. Scroll the menu section to see everything.

qa.q: What combos do you have and how much are they?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99 and Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99. All come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: Every combo comes with fries and a soft drink. You can upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00 and the drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: It has homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños. It's $6.99 on its own.

qa.q: What is the Turkey Burger?
qa.a: Two 2oz turkey patties with lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce. It's $6.99.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger ($5.99) is a 4oz patty with American cheese. The Kids Combo ($11.99) adds fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have chicken?
qa.a: Yes. The app lists a Chicken Sandwich Combo for $12.99 and lets you build a chicken sandwich with a hand-breaded fillet. Chicken strips also appear in the game and specials.

qa.q: What shakes do you have?
qa.a: Vanilla, chocolate or a Mix Shake (both), which is $4.99. You can also upgrade a combo drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces are $1.00 each, including Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Thunder, Ranch and Avocado Crema also appear in the app.

qa.q: Do you have onion rings and fries?
qa.a: Yes, both are on the menu. Combos come with fries, and you can upgrade to onion rings for +$2.00.

qa.q: Do you have lemonade?
qa.a: Lemonade appears in the app, but I don't have its price. Ask staff.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Build your burger tool in the app, pick your toppings, tap Grill it and place your order. The base burger is $2.74 with a brioche bun and Storm sauce.

qa.q: How much do burger toppings cost?
qa.a: Smash patty $2.50 each, American or Swiss cheese $0.75, bacon $2.00, jalapeños $1.00. Onion straws, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles are free.

qa.q: Can I build a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes, use the Chicken sandwich tab in the builder. The base is $2.00 and a crispy hand-breaded fillet is $4.99. A spicy Thunder fillet is also $4.99.

qa.q: Can I see the burgers in 3D?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 3D badge on a menu photo to see it built layer by layer. You can swipe to spin it.

qa.q: Are the menu photos real?
qa.a: The food photos are AI-generated previews of Storm Burger's real menu items.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or gluten-free options?
qa.a: I don't have allergy or diet details. Please ask staff before you order.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: I don't see alcohol on the menu in the app. No game or app prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes. The app lists seasonal specials such as Thunder Night Combo (Halloween), Gobble Burger (Thanksgiving) and Holiday Shake Stack (Christmas). Ask about the current one in the app.

qa.q: What is the Thanksgiving special?
qa.a: The Gobble Burger is a Turkey Burger plus Onion Rings. It runs Nov 20–28.

qa.q: What is the Christmas special?
qa.a: The Holiday Shake Stack is a Double Classic StormBurger with a Mix Shake (vanilla and chocolate). It runs Dec 15–25.

qa.q: What is the New Year special?
qa.a: The New Year BBQ Combo is a Bacon BBQ Burger Combo. It runs Dec 29–Jan 1.

qa.q: What is the Valentine's special?
qa.a: Burgers for Two is two Classic StormBurgers plus one Chocolate Shake with two straws. It runs Feb 7–14.

qa.q: What other holiday specials are there?
qa.a: Lucky Strips Combo (Mar 14–17), Cinco Spicy Combo (May 1–5) and Fourth of July Classic (Jul 1–4). Thunder Night Combo ran Oct 20–31 with code BOO.

qa.q: What are the special prices?
qa.a: The app doesn't show prices for the holiday specials. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I join Storm Burger Rewards?
qa.a: Join in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free. You need one account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, the member account is free. No purchase is needed to play the game or spin the daily wheel.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app offers free fries with your next burger. You also earn bonus points on your first order.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free for anyone, as often as you like. You only need a free account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend. You also get bonuses for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals, plus the daily spin.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points for every $1 spent.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit?
qa.a: Showing your member QR at a visit earns a 50-point check-in bonus (once a day). Your first order earns an extra 100 points.

qa.q: How do I get my points added at the register?
qa.a: Show your member QR code or code to the cashier when you pay.

qa.q: What can I redeem my points for?
qa.a: 1,000 pts: Free fries. 1,800 pts: Free shake. 3,000 pts: Free Classic StormBurger. 4,500 pts: Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free burger?
qa.a: 3,000 points gets a Free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Choose the reward in the app once you have enough points, then show it at the counter. A team member can help if you get stuck.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have any information about point expiration. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value and can only be traded for the rewards in the app.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. Add your birthday to your account and you get a 200-point birthday bonus.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: The app gives a 200-point bonus for your birthday when your birthday is on your account. I don't have other birthday club details.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Share your code with a friend. You get 150 points when they join, then 100 points on their first order and 25 points on each order after. Your friend gets 50 points and free fries.

qa.q: Can I earn points for giving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. In-app feedback earns 250 points. Google reviews don't earn points, and we only want honest ones.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being near the restaurant?
qa.a: If you turn on location and you're within 2 miles, the app gives a heads-up. It says to show it at the counter for double stars on today's order.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have any early-bird bonus. The check-in bonus (50 points) is for showing your QR at a visit.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have details on member levels. What I can tell you is the reward ladder: 1,000, 1,800, 3,000 and 4,500 points.

qa.q: What is the daily spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something, from bonus points to food and discounts.

qa.q: What can I win on the daily spin?
qa.a: +100 points (30%), +200 points (20%), +150 points (15%), free house sauce (15%), $2 off any burger (8%), free fries (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. Spins are always free and can't be bought or earned by purchasing.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location. It's one reward per visit and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: Storm Run is the game in the app. You drive a food truck from Inglewood to Long Beach, grabbing coins and food while dodging lightning, cops, tornadoes and more.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Swipe left or right on the road to change lanes, or tap the left or right side to move one lane. On a computer, use the left and right arrow keys.

qa.q: What are the game controls?
qa.a: Swipe left or right, tap a side of the screen, use the ◀ ▶ buttons, or press the arrow keys on a keyboard. A game controller also works.

qa.q: How does scoring work in Storm Run?
qa.a: Coins are +10 and food is +30 to +60. Hits take points off (about −100). Each level you finish adds a bonus of 100 times the level number.

qa.q: How many points is each food in the game?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger +60, Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich +50, Chicken Strips +50, Vanilla Shake +40, Lemonade +40, Fries +30, Onion Rings +30.

qa.q: What should I dodge in the game?
qa.a: Lightning (move off the glowing target), flying cows, stop signs, police cars and tornadoes. Roadblocks and spike strips show up on later levels.

qa.q: How many lives do I have?
qa.a: 5 lives. Each hit costs half a life, so 10 hits ends your run.

qa.q: How long is a run?
qa.a: There are 10 levels of 90 seconds each. The first 10 seconds are calm so you can get the feel of the controls.

qa.q: What is the Jordan High pit stop?
qa.a: On some levels you can pull into the Jordan High pit stop and play a quick kitchen mini-game. Build burgers in order for +75 points each, and each one repairs the truck (+1 life, up to 5).

qa.q: What are the Antidote Drizzle emblems?
qa.a: Catch 5 Antidote Drizzle emblems (+25 each) to unlock Antidote's StormBurger review on a roadside billboard. Drive through its golden ▶ for a +500 bonus.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in the game?
qa.a: One run over 400 points wins a free house sauce, 600 a free fries or onion rings, 800 a free milkshake, and 1,000 a free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: After your run, join or sign in to save the prize and get your code. Show the code on your phone at StormBurger to redeem.

qa.q: How long do game prizes last?
qa.a: You must use a game prize within 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.

qa.q: How often can I play Storm Run?
qa.a: As often as you like, and it's free. Tokens aren't currently turned on.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close is the weekly champion. The board resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo for the top score by Sunday close.

qa.q: When is the weekly prize decided?
qa.a: At Sunday close, and the board starts fresh every Monday. I don't have the exact pickup time, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do I need to buy something to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts in the game?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Who can play and win?
qa.a: U.S. residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Employees and their households can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Does the game have sound and music?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the Sound button to turn it on or off. There are two songs, Energy and Cheat Code, and you can tap the 🎵 button to switch.

qa.q: Can I change the game view or graphics?
qa.a: Yes, in the game's Settings. Choose 3D chase cam or Classic 2D, and pick a Graphics level (Smooth is recommended).

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. A Bluetooth or USB controller works in most browsers. Use the stick or D-pad to change lanes.

qa.q: What is the halftime video?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, a short break plays clips of Antidote The Foodie's review of Storm Burger. You can skip it, watch the full review on YouTube, or go back to the game.

qa.q: Is my best score saved?
qa.a: Yes. Your best score is saved on your phone. To get on the weekly board and claim prizes, save it with a member account.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: I don't see trivia or sports features in this app.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have kid mode details. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission, and there's a Kids Burger and Kids Combo on the menu.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 language button to translate the page. Common choices include English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone's home screen?
qa.a: On iPhone Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card details. Your member QR and code in the app are what you show the cashier.

qa.q: Does Storm Burger have an Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @stormburger. The app shows their latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, use the Write a Google review button in the app. Honest reviews only, and no points or prizes are given for Google reviews.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. If you opt in to texts or emails, you can stop them anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: How do I stop text messages?
qa.a: Reply STOP to any text, or use the unsubscribe link in an email.

qa.q: Can I get help from a staff member?
qa.a: Yes, just ask at the counter. They can help with orders, rewards and prizes.
